message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: PHP Lint

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '.github/workflows/php-lint.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - '**.php'
      - '.github/workflows/php-lint.yml'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.operating-system }}

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        operating-system: ['ubuntu-latest']
        php-versions: ['8.1', '8.2', '8.3', '8.4', '8.5', '8.6']

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Git repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup PHP ${{ matrix.php-versions }}
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: ${{ matrix.php-versions }}
          coverage: none
          tools: composer:v2

      - name: Cache Composer dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.composer/cache
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-versions }}-v1
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-${{ matrix.php-versions }}-v1
            ${{ runner.os }}-composer-

      - name: Install lint tools
        run: |
          composer global require --no-interaction --prefer-dist \
            php-parallel-lint/php-parallel-lint \
            staabm/annotate-pull-request-from-checkstyle

          echo "$(composer global config bin-dir --absolute)" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Run PHP Parallel Lint on PHP ${{ matrix.php-versions }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          parallel-lint . --exclude vendor --checkstyle --show-deprecated | cs2pr",
  "rationale": "Adds a Composer dependency download cache (actions/cache@v4) for ~/.composer/cache, keyed by runner OS and PHP version, before the existing composer global require install step. This reuses downloaded package archives across repeated matrix runs and re-runs without changing the install, lint, or coverage behavior, matching the dependency_cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE). No permissions, secrets, deployment steps, or new network access are added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
